name: NCNPS Alice Zawadzki Land Conservation Fund
summary: Small grants from the North Carolina Native Plant Society to land conservancies and conservation groups for land purchase, surveys, legal fees and floristic inventories that protect native plant habitat.
reporting: Recipients acknowledge the fund in materials, send a short project description and photos for the society's newsletter and website, and report significant changes to project dates.

eligibility.rule: Be a land conservancy, non-profit group, or agency involved in conservation of native plant habitat
Project is not planting natives on own, school or town-park property

calls.label: Annual review, deadline June 1
calls.recurring: Submission deadline is June 1 of each year, as the funder states; the page gives no year.

amount.quote: Each year NCNPS typically funds two to three Alice Zawadzki Land Conservation grants up to $3,000 each for land purchases that conserve natural plant habitats and communities.
